sources.title: Natural Earth 10m Admin 1 States, Provinces, version 5.1.1 as stated in retained README
sources.license: The retained Natural Earth repository LICENSE states vector/raster map data is public domain; the README describes source status and warns the product is beta and can be difficult to keep current. This is a regional grouping/context source, not authoritative current Chinese legal boundaries.
sources.observed: The retained table attributes first-order China features to the dataset region Southwest China: Chongqing (Municipality), Guizhou (Province), Sichuan (Province), Tibet (Autonomous Region), Yunnan (Province).
sources.use_limit: Supports only Natural Earth’s source-defined first-order grouping and component types at the 2022 repository vintage. It does not establish WorldAtlas tier design, current legal status, correct county boundaries, completeness, or topology.
sources.restoration: Read the exact Natural Earth commit and use the retained README/license and shapefile components under the referenced regional-review packet. Do not download a current release in place of the pinned source.

sources.title: Yunnan Provincial Civil Affairs Department, 行政区划设置 (Administrative Division Setup)
sources.access: Official search-index extracts were accessible on 2026-10-05; direct page fetch timed out in both web open and local HTTP retrieval. No original response bytes retained.
sources.license: No explicit reuse terms verified; facts and citation only. Do not mirror the full page/table without checking terms.
sources.observed: The official page reports 129 county-level units for Yunnan, 16 prefecture-level cities/autonomous prefectures, and lists county-level units by prefecture. It reports Honghe 13 (4 county-level cities, 6 counties, 3 autonomous counties), Qujing 9 (3 districts, 1 county-level city, 5 counties), Zhaotong 11 (1 county-level city, 1 district, 9 counties), and Wenshan 8 (1 county-level city, 7 counties).
sources.use_limit: Current roster evidence for the 2025-09-30 snapshot only. It does not resolve 2017 polygon identity, 2020 parent assignment lineage, current boundary geometry, historical persistence, island/fragment completeness, or reuse rights for the source page.
sources.restoration: Retrieve the Civil Affairs page at the exact URL. Preserve the response and retrieval timestamp if reuse is permitted; hash the bytes. Capture the county-level table entries for Honghe, Qujing, Zhaotong and Wenshan. Compare official code/name rows against every scoped source ID and preserve unmatched rows without reassignment.

sources.title: Yunnan Provincial Civil Affairs Department release page for DB53/T 1176-2023 administrative village/community code standards
sources.publisher: Yunnan Provincial Civil Affairs Department, jointly with Provincial Market Regulation Administration and Provincial Institute of Standardization per the page
sources.access: Official page/PDFs appeared in search-index records on 2026-10-05; direct page and PDF fetches timed out. No source bytes retained.
sources.license: No explicit PDF reuse terms verified. Facts and citation only; do not mirror the standards until reuse terms are checked.
sources.observed: The release page links area-specific standards including DB53/T 1176.3 (Qujing), .6 (Zhaotong), .11 (Honghe), and .12 (Wenshan). Indexed table-of-contents extracts identify the prefecture-level jurisdiction and its county/city administrative-code table.
sources.use_limit: Administrative names/codes and jurisdiction structure do not supply boundary polygons and cannot establish geometry or county completeness by themselves.
sources.restoration: Open the release page, retrieve each of the four linked official PDFs when allowed, record final URL, bytes, SHA-256, access time and reuse terms, then compare table 1 code/name rows with the scoped 2017 source and the dated 2025 roster.

sources.title: Qujing Municipal Government history of the 1997 administrative reorganization
sources.source_vintage: Describes the 1997 reorganization; page retrieved/stream-hashed 2026-10-05 by the prior #451 source review.
sources.license: No explicit reuse terms verified; facts and citation only. Response body was not retained by the prior packet.
sources.observed: The source history states prefecture-level Qujing was established in 1997 and former county-level Qujing City was divided into Qilin and Zhanyi districts.
sources.use_limit: Historical administrative context does not identify which polygon, if any, the 2017 source's Qujingshi geometry represents.
sources.restoration: Fetch the official URL and verify the 1997 paragraph and exact response hash before relying on it as retained evidence. Resolve the old feature only against an authoritative map/code crosswalk.
